severities.STOP: Contraindication/high-risk conflict. Standard prescription must be blocked until resolved.
severities.ALERT: Clinically significant risk requiring active prescriber review/alternative/monitoring.
severities.CAUTION: Use with caution; review dose, monitoring, timing or patient factors.

fluoroquinolones: ciprofloxacin 3 mg/mL + dexamethasone 1 mg/mL ear drops

interactions.message: Concomitant medicine is contraindicated with clarithromycin in the cited SmPC.
interactions.action: Choose an alternative antibiotic or resolve the interacting medicine before prescribing.

interactions.message: Clarithromycin may increase anticoagulant exposure/bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Review alternative antibiotic and, if coadministration is necessary, use product-specific monitoring/management.

interactions.message: Ondansetron with apomorphine is contraindicated due to profound hypotension/loss of consciousness.
Concomitant QT-prolonging treatment may add to ondansetron QT risk.
interactions.action: Review QT risk, electrolytes and alternative therapy; ECG monitoring may be appropriate.

interactions.message: Serotonin syndrome has been reported with ondansetron plus serotonergic medicines.
interactions.action: Review serotonergic burden and counsel/monitor for serotonin toxicity.

interactions.message: Co-trimoxazole may increase free methotrexate exposure and antifolate toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid unless specifically justified; review blood-count/folate/toxicity monitoring.

interactions.message: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole can cause clinically relevant hyperkalaemia with potassium-raising medicines.
interactions.action: Review necessity and potassium/renal monitoring or choose an alternative.
Prefer non-NSAID analgesia where possible or review bleeding-risk mitigation.

interactions.message: NSAID with ACEi/ARB and/or diuretic can worsen renal function, especially with dehydration.
interactions.action: Review hydration, renal risk and alternative analgesia; consider renal monitoring.

interactions.message: Concomitant corticosteroids or SSRIs increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk with NSAIDs.
interactions.action: Review GI bleeding risk and alternative analgesia.

interactions.message: Rizatriptan is contraindicated with MAO inhibitors, ergot derivatives and other 5-HT1B/1D agonists.
interactions.action: Do not coadminister; observe product-specific washout intervals.
Use the product-specific reduced 5 mg regimen and review pediatric appropriateness; do not use the standard 10 mg band.

interactions.message: Aluminium/magnesium antacids can reduce fexofenadine absorption.
interactions.action: Separate administration according to the exact product SmPC.

condition_rules.message: Surgical red flags invalidate routine outpatient medication treatment.
Active anaphylaxis requires immediate adrenaline/emergency treatment, not routine outpatient medication selection.
Significant hypoxaemia is incompatible with routine outpatient medication-only management.
condition_rules.action: Stabilize and use the respiratory/emergency pathway.

condition_rules.message: Suspected sepsis overrides routine outpatient medication pathways.
Oral outpatient treatment is incompatible with inability to tolerate oral medication/fluids.
The patient has an admission-level clinical indication.
condition_rules.action: Do not use a routine discharge prescription pathway.

condition_rules.message: Clinical instability invalidates routine outpatient medication selection.
condition_rules.action: Use the emergency/resuscitation/admission pathway before outpatient prescribing.

condition_rules.message: Clarithromycin is contraindicated with known QT prolongation or ventricular arrhythmia.
Clarithromycin is contraindicated with hypokalaemia/hypomagnesaemia due to QT risk.
Ondansetron adds QT/arrhythmia risk in patients with QT prolongation or ventricular arrhythmia.
Electrolyte abnormalities increase ondansetron-associated arrhythmia risk.
condition_rules.action: Correct electrolytes and reassess QT risk.

condition_rules.message: Ibuprofen should be avoided in dehydration because of renal risk.
condition_rules.action: Use alternative analgesia/antipyresis and treat dehydration.

condition_rules.message: Pregnancy changes the benefit-risk profile of several antiparasitic regimens.
condition_rules.action: Review pregnancy-specific guidance/product labeling before prescribing.

condition_rules.message: Pregnancy changes NSAID benefit-risk and gestational-age restrictions apply.
condition_rules.action: Review gestational age and pregnancy-specific NSAID guidance before prescribing.

duplicate_rules.message: Duplicate NSAID therapy increases renal/GI toxicity.
Duplicate systemic corticosteroid therapy can cause unintended cumulative exposure.
Duplicate antihistamine therapy may add adverse effects without benefit.
Duplicate macrolide therapy is usually unintended and may increase QT/adverse-effect burden.
